115.description: This feature vector activates strongly on common Hindi characters, vowels, and word fragments, as well as the English letter 'A'.

180.description: This vector represents sequential numerical values within the one-hundred-eighties range.

193.description: This vector represents common inflectional suffixes and vowel-consonant clusters in the Hindi language.

43.description: This feature vector detects fragments of Hindi script and text tokens.

52.description: These tokens represent consonant-vowel combinations and common syllabic blocks in North Indic scripts like Hindi.

126.description: This vector represents characters, diacritics, and sub-word fragments commonly found in Indic scripts like Hindi and related Devanagari text.

141.description: These tokens represent short Hindi verb roots or stems starting with common consonants (like ब, ल, ह, क, स, द).

116.description: This vector represents Hindi vowel signs and dependent vowel modifiers, particularly the dependent vowel 'e' (ê) and its combining character forms.

30.description: This vector activates on fragments of Hindi script and text.

86.description: This vector activates on non-English script fragments and subword tokens from various writing systems such as Devanagari and Vietnamese.
